companies.name: Apple
companies.sub: スマートフォン・端末

relations.text: 2025年12月期のRobux販売のうち、Apple App Store経由が売上の29%を占める
relations.text_en: For the year ended December 31, 2025, 29% of Roblox's revenue was attributable to Robux sales through the Apple App Store

source.label: Roblox 10-K
source.quote: For the year ended December 31, 2025, 29% of our revenue was attributable to Robux sales through the Apple App Store and 15% of our revenue was attributable to Robux sales through the Google Play Store.
source.note: 配信チャネルとしての関係です。

relations.text: 2025年12月期のRobux販売のうち、Google Playストア経由が売上の15%を占める
relations.text_en: For the year ended December 31, 2025, 15% of Roblox's revenue was attributable to Robux sales through the Google Play Store

source.label: Roblox 10-K
source.quote: For the year ended December 31, 2025, 29% of our revenue was attributable to Robux sales through the Apple App Store and 15% of our revenue was attributable to Robux sales through the Google Play Store.

companies.name: テンセント
companies.sub: インターネット・ゲーム

relations.text: 2019年2月にTencent関連会社のSonghuaと合弁契約を結び、Roblox側が51%を持つRoblox China Holding Corp(China JV)を設立した
relations.text_en: In February 2019, Roblox entered into a joint venture agreement with Songhua, an affiliate of Tencent Holdings, creating Roblox China Holding Corp, of which Roblox owns 51%

source.label: Roblox 10-K
source.quote: In February 2019, we entered into a joint venture agreement with Songhua River Investment Limited, referred to as Songhua, an affiliate of Tencent Holdings Limited (“Tencent Holdings”), under which we created Roblox China Holding Corp (the “China JV”), of which we own a 51% ownership interest.

relations.text: Tencentは中国政府の出版ライセンスを得て、Robloxクライアントの現地版を「Luobulesi」の名で中国で配信できるようになった
relations.text_en: Tencent received a publishing license from the Chinese government, enabling it to publish a localized version of the Roblox Client in China as 'Luobulesi'

source.label: Roblox 10-K
source.quote: Ltd (“Tencent”), received a required publishing license from the Chinese government, which enabled Tencent to publish a localized version of the Roblox Client as a game in China under the name “Luobulesi.” The license could be withdrawn if Tencent fails to comply with applicable existing or future regulations.

relations.text: 2025年第2四半期に、Shopifyを最初の連携パートナーとしてRoblox Commerce APIsを開始した
relations.text_en: In Q2 2025, Roblox launched Roblox Commerce APIs with Shopify as its inaugural integrated partner

source.label: Roblox 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: In Q2 2025, we also launched Roblox Commerce APIs, with Shopify as our inaugural integrated partner and the Approved Merchandiser Program, bridging physical goods with virtual benefits to our platform.

relations.text: Lionsgate、Netflix、Sega、Kodanshaを主要なIPパートナーとして開始した
relations.text_en: Roblox launched with prominent IP partners Lionsgate, Netflix, Sega and Kodansha

source.label: Roblox 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: We've launched with prominent IP partners Lionsgate, Netflix, Sega, and Kodansha.
